sources.title: MultiWikiQA: A Reading Comprehension Benchmark in 300+ Languages
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce a new reading comprehension dataset, dubbed MultiWikiQA, which covers 306 languages. The context data comes from Wikipedia articles, with questions generated by an LLM and the answers appearing verbatim in the Wikipedia articles.
